scope: Read-only concurrency review, no performance inference
resets: create init0 and scanRecovery pending before pointer publication only
shared_updates: published shared high_water only monotonic fetchMax; reclaim changes occupied only
mode: single/exclusive producer uses original conditional store; retire/reactivate do not reset peak; producer_mode fixed
safety: If c<=observed_peak, every subsequent modification is>=observed_peak>=c. Stale low reads only cause redundant fetchMax. A low updater after higher max cannot decrease the atomic maximum.
ordering: Peak is monotonic diagnostic state, not a release/acquire synchronization variable. Slot/turn and admissions publication unchanged.
